proposed_product_tests.requirement: Supported aspect input preserves full native obligation identities/payloads and output ordering
Normalized SPEC fixture preserves full native obligation identities/payloads
Mixed input selects the declared dialect, reports alternate ignored sources and never doubles obligations
Absent input or malformed tables/endpoints yields reject, diagnostic sources, and no success artifact
Unparseable formal content retains needs-formal; it is not guessed or dropped
Machine inputs retain selected profile identities; stale source/graph/registry references reject
Unsupported machine profile/material remains explicit; no Markdown fallback or forced parity
Changed-file selection handles repository-relative v2 paths, spaces, containment, rename/delete and Git failure
No-work is distinct from full-scan PASS; changed selected files have normal-scan-equivalent diagnostics
Frozen legacy code, accepted candidates and waiver bytes stay unchanged
Rollback selects the previous exact entry point/input bindings and keeps failed-candidate evidence

formal_define_runtime_validation: not_evaluable; native candidate only, no saved session/runtime admission
